_comment: Copy this somewhere outside the repo and point WAYFARE_CONVENTIONS at it.
These strings decide what your calendar entries look like; nothing here
is personal data, which is why the example is safe to commit.
_train_title: Rail, coach and ferry share this. Adds {operator} and {mode}.
_reminders: Minutes before the event. Two on a flight: the first is the cue to leave,
the second the cue that you should already be at the desk. [] uses the
calendar's own default. Google allows at most five, none over four weeks.
